neuschwanstein.name: Neuschwanstein Castle
neuschwanstein.slogan: A king's opera set, built in stone above the Pöllat gorge.
neuschwanstein.line: Holy and unapproachable, a worthy temple for the divine friend.
neuschwanstein.by: Ludwig II, letter to Richard Wagner, May 1868

wieskirche.name: Wieskirche
wieskirche.slogan: A pilgrimage church that floats in a Rococo sky.
wieskirche.line: Built by the brothers Johann Baptist and Dominikus Zimmermann between 1745 and 1754, it became a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1983.

hohenschwangau.name: Hohenschwangau Castle
hohenschwangau.slogan: The yellow summer palace where a boy king dreamed up Neuschwanstein.
hohenschwangau.line: Rebuilt for Maximilian II of Bavaria from 1833, it was the childhood home of his sons Ludwig II and Otto.

nebelhorn.name: Nebelhorn
nebelhorn.slogan: Above the fog line, with the whole Allgäu Alps at your feet.
nebelhorn.line: A cable car has carried visitors up the 2,224 m Nebelhorn above Oberstdorf since 1930.

cambodunum.name: Cambodunum
cambodunum.slogan: Roman streets under Kempten, older than most of Germany.
cambodunum.line: The Celtic town of Kambodunon is mentioned by Strabo around 50 BC, the oldest written reference to any German city.
